title: fix(plugin-report): a report draws a dataset dimension nullLabel for its null bucket
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbNoZJxAjLuNF5LVf8GtR5wQ)_

Fixes #29010

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：数据集维度声明了 `nullLabel`（如 "No region"）时，报表里该维度的空值不再显示 "—"，而是显示这个名字。覆盖汇总表的行和分组标题、矩阵的行标题和列标题、报表内嵌图表的空值类目，以及 CSV/XLSX 导出，导出与屏幕上的字一致。没声明 `nullLabel` 的维度照旧显示 "—"。
- **为什么改**：同一个数据集在仪表盘上读作 "No region"，在报表里却是 "—"，读报表的人分不清"空值"和"缺数据"；spec 原文要求渲染器用这个名字画空值，仪表盘早已照做，报表没有。
- **风险与回滚**：低。只改 `plugin-report` 一个文件的显示文字；分组、合计、钻取仍读原始值，非空值（包括空字符串）显示不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：① `ui/packages/plugin-report/src/DatasetReportRenderer.tsx` 新增的 `dimensionText` 及其六处调用；② 同文件的 `declaredNullCategoryLabel`（图表空值类目，照抄仪表盘规则：透视图两个维度声明同一个名字才用）；③ 新测试 `DatasetReportRenderer.nullLabel-29010.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-report/src/__tests__/DatasetReportRenderer.nullLabel-29010.test.tsx`，预期 8 个测试全绿（空值行、分组标题、矩阵行/列标题、CSV、图表类目都读 "No region (R8)"，未声明的维度仍是 "—"）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

A dataset dimension can name its null bucket with `nullLabel`, and the dataset query answer carries it on the column descriptor, `fields[].nullLabel`, already resolved to the request locale. The spec (`packages/spec/src/api/analytics.zod.ts`, `nullLabel`) says: "A renderer draws the column's null values under it instead of its own default." The dashboard widget did (`DatasetWidget.tsx`, `nullLabelOf`); the report drew `formatDimensionValue`'s "—" everywhere.

`ui/packages/plugin-report/src/DatasetReportRenderer.tsx` only:

- **`dimensionText(fields, dimension, value, locale)`** (module-local): a null value reads as the column's declared `nullLabel` when the answer carries one; otherwise, and for every non-null value, it is `formatDimensionValue(value, locale)` unchanged (an empty string stays an empty string). It reads the label off the answer the report already holds (`state.fields`), the way the dashboard widget does; nothing is resolved from metadata a second time, and `@object-ui/core`'s `formatDimensionValue` is untouched.
- It replaces `formatDimensionValue` at every site the report draws a dimension value: the summary table's detail cells and their export cells, the grouped summary's group headers and their export cells, the matrix row headers and their export cells, and `bucketLabel` (the matrix row/column header labels, so the across-axis headers and their export header cells too).
- **The report's embedded chart** (an extra site, agreed with the seat in the card thread): its null category was `tt('chart.nullCategory', '(None)')`. It now takes `declaredNullCategoryLabel(state.fields, queryDimensions, [yAxis])` first, a plugin-report-local copy of the dashboard widget's rule: the x-axis dimension's label, and on a `seriesBy` pivot only when both dimensions declare the same one; otherwise "(None)" as before. The same resolved label keeps the empty series last in the series ordering.
- Bucket ids, cell lookups, drill payloads and grouping read the raw value as before; this is display copy only.

## Tests

New `ui/packages/plugin-report/src/__tests__/DatasetReportRenderer.nullLabel-29010.test.tsx` (8 tests, real `DatasetReportRenderer` over a `queryDataset` double whose answer declares `nullLabel` on `region` and none on `kind`):

- summary: the null row reads the label on screen, and the CSV equals the drawn table;
- control: a column without `nullLabel` keeps "—", and an empty-string value stays blank, on screen and in the CSV;
- grouped summary: the null group header reads the label (the inner undeclared null keeps "—"), CSV equals the drawn table;
- matrix: the null row header reads the label while an undeclared across-axis null header keeps "—", CSV equal;
- matrix: the null across-axis header reads the label, CSV header equal;
- chart: the x-axis null category reads the label; control: an undeclared x-axis keeps "(None)"; a `seriesBy` pivot takes the label only when both dimensions declare the same one.

Ablations (subject imported from `src` by relative path, so no build leg; each run under `os-verify-lock`, restored and proved by blob hash equal to `HEAD` and an empty `git diff HEAD`):

- the whole renderer reverted to `origin/main` (blob `cd8213a1`, `dimensionText(` count 0) at `481cc948`: 4 red, the "—" control green;
- the chart site only, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `0b68fe40` to `b77c6c08`) at `345a95fb`: 2 red (x-axis label, pivot), the other 6 green.

## Acceptance notes

- **Measured on a real backend** (`examples/app-crm` under `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`, the Vite source Console proxying to it, Chromium). Scratch package `app.qar8` with object `qar8_dsobj`, dataset `qar8_dataset` (`region` with `nullLabel: 'No region (R8)'`, `kind` without), reports `qar8_report` (summary), `qar8_matrix` (rows region, columns kind), `qar8_matrix_across` (rows kind, columns region) and `qar8_chart` (summary with a bar chart on region); rows seeded with region null. The page's own query answer carried `fields.region.nullLabel = "No region (R8)"`.

  | report | before (origin/main) | after (this branch) |
  |---|---|---|
  | `qar8_report` screen / CSV | `— \| 2 \| 37` / `—,2,37` | `No region (R8) \| 2 \| 37` / `No region (R8),2,37` |
  | `qar8_matrix` row header / CSV | `—` / `—,30,7,—,37` | `No region (R8)` / `No region (R8),30,7,—,37` (the `kind` null column header stays `—`) |
  | `qar8_matrix_across` column header / CSV header | `Kind,—,North,South,Total` | `Kind,No region (R8),North,South,Total` (the `kind` null row header stays `—`) |
  | `qar8_chart` x-axis ticks | `(None)`, North, South | `No region (R8)`, North, South |

  The export leg needed one harness step: the dev admin holds no `allowExport` grant (the built-in admin sets never carry it, by design), so the browser's `/me/permissions` answer was patched to add `export` on the scratch object. The CSV itself is the renderer's own snapshot.
- The report chart site was not in the card; the seat agreed in the card thread to fold it in, as the same defect in the same file.
- `formatDimensionValue` in `@object-ui/core` and `plugin-dashboard` are untouched; `declaredNullCategoryLabel` is a local copy of the dashboard's rule rather than a new shared helper.
- eslint on the two touched files: 0 errors; the renderer's 5 `react-refresh` warnings are the same count as on main; the new test file carries 8 `no-explicit-any` warnings on chart-prop reads, as the sibling chart tests do.

## Verification

Head `ae73251f`: origin/main merged twice (`39951d2a` at `3b3fef03`, `6dd6a534` at `ae73251f`), both clean; neither brought a change to `ui/packages/plugin-report` or `ui/packages/core`, and no parallel `nullLabel` fix exists on main.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 34 commands, all exit 0 at `5ed3317b` (the same 3 paths as the head); `--ran` reconciles 34 derived, 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-report/` at the head: 33 files, 307 passed, 7 skipped (the new file's 8 included).
- `pnpm exec turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/plugin-report` at the head: 48 tasks, green.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` at `5ed3317b`: 169 files passed, 2 skipped. `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` at the head: 0.
